Alɩf, Lɑɑm, Miim.
Gafã sikrã sãmbg kɑe t'a yii bõn-nɑɑndsã fãɑ Soɑbã nengẽ ye.
Bɩ b yetɑme t'ɑ (Mʋhammad) wʋg-ɑ lɑme? Ayo, yẽ lɑ sɩdã sẽn yi fo Soɑbã nengẽ bʋɩl yĩng tɩ fo na bugs neb bugsd sẽn da kɑ wa b nengẽ sẽn na yɩlẽ tɩ b bãng sor n dɩke.

Wẽnd lɑ sẽn nɑɑn sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã lɑ sẽn be b yiibã sʋk rɑsem ɑ yoob pʋgẽ, rẽ poorẽ t'A zẽk Al-ʿarsã (Naamã goeel) yĩngri (zẽkr sẽn tog ne Wẽnde), yãmb kɑ tɑr lɑlld lɑ sugsd tɩ kɑ Yẽ ye, rẽ yĩngɑ y kɑ nɑ n tẽege?
A rabsda yellã tɩ yit sɑɑgẽ wã n wɑt Tẽngã, rẽ poorẽ t'a rʋʋd A nengẽ rɑɑr sẽn zem yãmb sẽn sõt to-to wã yʋʋm tusri.
Yẽ lɑ yel-soondɩ la yel-vẽeneg Mitɑ, A yaa Windɑ n yaa Yoalsda.
Soɑb ning sẽn mɑnegd bũmb ning A sẽn nɑɑn fãɑ tɩ yɩɩd ne manegre; lɑ A sɩng ninsɑɑl naoonegã ne tãndo.
Rẽ poorẽ t'A nɑɑn ɑ koɑmbã tɩ b yit ko-yɑɑlgẽ.
Rẽ poorẽ t'A pids ɑ naoonegã lɑ A fʋʋs ɑ pʋgẽ sẽn yi A vɩɩmẽ wã, t'a paam vɩɩm, lɑ A nɑɑn wʋmb lɑ nenem lɑ yɑm n kõ yãmbɑ, yãmb kɑ pẽgde rẽndɑ bɩlf bɑlɑ.
Lɑ b yeele: "rẽ yĩngɑ tõnd sã n ki lɑ d lebg tom lɑ kõɑbɑ rẽ yĩngɑ tõnd nɑ n le lebɑ naaneg-pɑɑll pʋgẽ?" Ayo, bãmbɑ yɑɑ yɑgsdb ne b Soɑbã sεgbã.
Yeele: "kũum tẽn-tʋmdã (mɑlεgsã) b sẽn dɩk n boblg yãmbã nɑ n deegɑ yãmb yõyã, rẽ poorẽ yãmb Soɑbã nengẽ lɑ b nɑ n lebs yãmbɑ".
Lɑk tɩ fo sã n yã yel-wẽn-mɑɑndbã b sẽn wɑt n sulg b zutã b Soɑbã nengẽ n yetẽ: "d Soɑbɑ! Tõnd yãame lɑ d wʋme, bɩ F lebs-d tɩ d nɑ tʋm tʋʋm-sõngo, ɑd tõnd yɑɑ bãng-n-wãɑk rãmbɑ".
Lɑ Tõnd sã n dɑ rɑtẽ D naan n kõ yõor fãa ɑ kãndgre, lɑ ad koεεg sɩdgɑme n yi Mɑm nengẽ tɩ Mɑm nɑ n pidsɑ Gεhãnnɑm ne zĩn-dãmb lɑ neba.
Bɩ y lemb yãmb sẽn da yĩm y rũndã sεkã yĩngɑ, bãng-y tɩ Tõnd yĩmɑ yãmb yelle, lɑ y lemb naong sẽn kɑ sate, y sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã yĩngɑ.
Ad sẽn kõt-b sɩd ne Tõnd goɑmã yɑɑ neb nins tɩ b sã n tẽeg-b ne-a lɑ b sẽn lʋɩt n yɑɑ tukdb lɑ b yɩlgd b Soɑbã yʋʋr ne pẽgr lɑ b kɑ mɑɑnd wɑoog-m-meng ye.
B kɩremsã lɑkdɑme n bɑsd gãasã zĩis n yik n bõosdb b Soɑbã yεεsg lɑ yã-beed yĩngɑ, lɑ b yãkd Tõnd sẽn dɩlg-ba n maand sãrã (neere).
Rẽnd yõor kɑ mi b sẽn solg n bĩng-ba sẽn yɑɑ sũ-noog lɑ nif-mɑɑgr ye, tɩ yɑɑ b sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã rolbo.
Rẽ yĩngɑ sɩd-kõt ne kɩfr zema tɑɑbɑ? B kɑ yɩt wɑ tɑɑb ye.
Lɑ sã n yɑɑ ne neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd lɑ b tʋm tʋʋm-sõɑmã wã, Mɑʿwɑɑ (gãɑg zĩig) arzãnã be b yĩngɑ, yɑɑ sigb zĩisi, b sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã rolbo.
Lɑ sã n yɑɑ ne neb nins sẽn tɑrg n bɑs so-sõngã, Bugmã lɑ b kõom zĩigɑ, b sã n dɑt n yi ɑ pʋgẽ wã fãa b lebsd-b-lɑ ɑ pʋgẽ wã, lɑ b yeel-ba: "lemb-y Bugum ning naong yãmb sẽn dɑ yɑgsdã".
Lɑ tɩ Tõnd nɑ lemb-b naon-bilã, naong-kẽengã tɑoore, sãnd-sãnd b nɑ tek n bɑse.
Lɑ ãnd wẽgb n le yɩɩd ned ning b sẽn tẽeg-ɑ ne ɑ Soɑbã goɑmã lɑ A yel-soɑlmã, rẽ poorẽ t'ɑ bɑll n bɑse? Bãng-y tɩ Tõnd nɑ n sɩbgɑ yel-wẽn-mɑɑndbã.
Lɑ sɩdɑ ɑd Tõnd kõo ɑ Musɑ Sebrã, bɩ f rɑ wɑ maan sãmbg ne ɑ sεgbã ye, lɑ D mɑɑn-ɑ t'ɑ yɑɑ kãndgd ɑ Isrɑɑɩɩl kɑmbã yĩngɑ.
Lɑ D mɑɑn Tɑoor rãmb tɩ yi b pʋgẽ wã tɩ b wilgd sor ne Tõnd sɑgl lɑ D rɑɑbo, b sẽn wɑ n mɑɑn sugrã. Lɑ b rɑ yɩɩme n yɑɑ bãng-n-wãɑk rãmb ne Tõnd goɑmã.
Ad fo Soɑbã, Yẽnd n nɑ n bʋ b ne tɑɑb sʋk Yikrã rɑɑr b sẽn dɑ yɩ n yõsd tɑɑb yεl nins zutã.
Rẽ yĩnga bãmbã pa paam vẽenem ne Tõnd sẽn halk neb wʋsg nins sẽn reng bãmb taoor tɩ bãmb pɩʋʋgd b zagsẽ wã la? Ad tɑgs-n-gεsgɑ be wã pʋgẽ, rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ kelgd lɑ?
Rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ yã tɩ Tõnd wɑtɑ ne koomã Tẽn-koεεngẽ n tɑll-ɑ n buls bõn-bundɩ tɩ bãmb rũmsã ne bãmb mensã rɩtẽ lɑ? Rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ ne lɑ?
Lɑ b yetẽ tɩ: yɑɑ sɑsɑ bʋg lɑ bʋʋd yẽne nɑ n yɩ tɩ yãmb sã n yɑɑ sɩd rãmbɑ?
Yeele: "bʋʋdã rɑɑrã kɩfr-dãmb sɩd-kũun kɑ nɑ n tɑll yõod ne-b ye, lɑ b leb n kɑ nɑ n yɑoolg bãmb me ye"
Bɩ f bɑll n bɑs-b lɑ f gũ, ad bãmb me yɑɑ gũudbɑ.
